RepoCoder supports iterative candidate-conditioned retrieval in repository code completion, a testable one-lookup research hypothesis, not a demonstrated architecture benefit. Seek supporting and contrary code. https://aclanthology.org/2023.emnlp-main.151.pdf §1 pp. 2471–72; lines 122–141, Table 2. Further iterations are nonmonotonic in the s4 source prefix; n836 duplication caveat and n494 API example unconfirmed.

TACL reports longer, lower-reward LM decision dialogues in three studied domains: evaluate decision quality and reviewer effort jointly. https://aclanthology.org/2024.tacl-1.50.pdf abstract/front matter; §7.2 specifics remain unverified. The n154 VOI finding remains unresolved: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.06152 bears a different title from the report, and content provenance is defective.

Publication established; independent peer-review status unknown. CodeRAG's multi-path retrieval is documented, but path-specific and pruning claims remain unresolved. https://aclanthology.org/2025.emnlp-main.1187.pdf abstract/methods, lines 118–163.
